race.comment: ROBRICK (10) came from worse than midfield to be beaten just 0.4 lengths in a Class 6 over this course and distance last start. Drops back to a Class 3, and not a terribly strong one at that. Very fit and from a good draw gets every chance to return to the winner's list. LOCKYER (12) came with a powerful finish but missed by a long neck last time out over 1400m at Eagle Farm. Tackles a weaker race here but does take a hike in the weights. Nevertheless, looks a serious chance with the blinkers applied for the first time. ALDOLFITO (1) has every chance but failed to run on as expected last start behind MELDUBIOUS. Capable of far better than that. MELDUBIOUS (7) scored in good style over 1400m at the Eagle Farm midweekers recently. Can progress to Saturday company.
